_README: All Apex figures here are VERIFIED against Apex's own help-center pages (EOD Evaluations, EOD Payouts, Legacy 30% MAE, Prohibited Activities), pasted by Jonathan Aug 2026. Everything under my_rules{} is MY design, not Apex's, and is deliberately stricter than Apex requires: Apex's rules let you pass an evaluation, these rules are built to get you a payout. Apex prohibits automation, so this tool never places an order — it gates, sizes, and journals. You place every fill by hand.

payout._note: VERIFIED from Apex's EOD Payouts page. Consistency is 50% (no single profitable day may be 50% or more of total profit since the last approved payout). 100% split, min $500 per request, max 6 payouts then the PA closes.

mae._note: REFERENCE ONLY, NOT ENFORCED. Apex's 30% Negative P&L (MAE) rule is titled 'Legacy', there is no EOD equivalent page, and the EOD payout rules never mention it — so it is treated as not applying to EOD accounts. Kept here because the per-trade risk cap in my_rules is far tighter than this ceiling would be anyway. Set enforce=true only if Apex support confirms it applies.

apex_prohibitions._note: VERIFIED from Apex's Prohibited Activities page. Apex's rules, not mine; several are enforced by this tool.

my_rules._note: My design. The daily target is a CEILING, not a goal to beat: it is Apex's minimum qualifying daily profit plus a small buffer for commissions, so one clean trade can finish the day, the day counts toward the 5-day requirement, and every day stays a similar size (which is what satisfies the 50% consistency rule). commission_round_trip figures are estimates — replace them with your platform's actual rates.
